# Trump approval hits record second-term low: Survey

President Trump’s job approval rating sits at a second-term low in a new postelection survey, showing little sign of improvement after his party suffered widespread losses in the midterms.

In the new Economist/YouGov poll, 63 percent of Americans said they disapproved of Trump’s job performance, including 52 percent who disapproved strongly, with just 32 percent approving. [...] On the issues, foreign policy and the economy remain the president’s weak points. Sixty-one percent of respondents disapproved of Trump’s foreign policy and 67 percent disapproved of his handling of the economy, his worst issue surveyed.
results.title: Trump hits second-term low in Economist/YouGov poll

results.content:
In its first post-election poll, the Economist/YouGov series has found the president 26 points underwater, with 36 percent approving of his job performance and 62 percent disapproving, a seven-point deterioration from the pollster’s final survey before Election Day.

That shift could be significant for Republican lawmakers deciding how closely to align themselves with a president whose core supporters remain loyal but whose broader standing could complicate the party’s recovery. [...] The latest Economist/YouGov survey questioned 3,166 registered voters from November 4 to 6 and had a margin of sampling error of plus or minus 2.2 percentage points, adjusted for weighting.

Data from the October 23-26 Economist/YouGov poll shows that 39% of registered voters approve of President Trump's job performance and 58% disapprove, a net approval rating of -19 percentage points.
